keywordAbilityEvidence.vocabulary: Recognized intrinsic keyword abilities and concrete targeting restrictions only; no claim to encode every free-text effect. Empty list means no recognized keyword ability, not no card effect. Implementation indicators AURA/TRIGGER_VISUAL and targeting/category metadata are observed separately.

chooseOneEvidence.meaning: Original parent ability boolean; not a flag for generated option entities.
chooseOneEvidence.baselineBasis: Original values are retained unchanged. Three true parents have their own explicit release Choose One text; six generated options are false. Whole baseline confidence remains partial.
